about: The field registry: every optional piece an event app can have, in plain language. v1 and v2 ship for seasonal holiday invites; other event types come later on the roadmap. The host names the holiday and the agent starts from that holiday's defaults. The interview agent reads ask_if, question and ask_extra; the build reads which modules are on. status: existing = in the template today, new = proposed. DRAFT: the holiday details (menu_ideas, ask_extra, design_mood) are first guesses to be reviewed by someone who celebrates each one. Field properties the tools read: ask:false = never ask the host (the build fills it); derive + derive_by = how a value is computed (code = gen-event.js does it, agent = the interviewer fills it from other answers, the host is not asked); default = what the site assumes when the key is absent; only_with = ask only while that module is on. required counts only while the field's module is on (always-on modules always).

event_types.label: Thanksgiving / Friendsgiving
event_types.typical_dates: Thanksgiving is the 4th Thursday of November. Friendsgiving is usually the weekend before or after.
event_types.blurb: Everyone will talk about your turkey for years!
event_types.design_mood: Warm harvest: amber, rust, candlelight, a long table.
ask_extra: Is this Thanksgiving Day or a Friendsgiving?
Who is cooking the turkey?
How do you want to bring people together?
What's a new tradition you want to create?

event_types.label: Christmas
event_types.typical_dates: Christmas Eve is Dec 24 and Christmas Day is Dec 25. Parties are often the weekend before.
event_types.blurb: Bring people together this holiday: a family meal, a cookie swap, a party...
event_types.design_mood: Evergreen and candlelight. Warm and cozy, not cartoon Santa.
ask_extra: Christmas Eve or Christmas Day?
Is it a party or a family meal?
Is there a gift exchange?
Is there a theme?
Will kids be there?
How would you like to bring people together?

event_types.label: Hanukkah
event_types.typical_dates: Eight nights starting at sundown; the dates change every year.
event_types.blurb: Celebrate Hanukkah with a gathering of family and friends
event_types.design_mood: Midnight blue and silver with candlelight. Elegant, not clip-art.
ask_extra: Which night of Hanukkah?
Is there a candle lighting, and when?
Should the food be kosher or kosher-style?
What games bring your gathering together?
Is there a gift exchange?

event_types.label: Kwanzaa
event_types.typical_dates: Seven nights, Dec 26 to Jan 1. The Karamu feast is traditionally Dec 31.
event_types.blurb: A Kwanzaa celebration: one night of the seven, or the Karamu feast.
event_types.design_mood: Red, black and green with a kinara; warm, proud and festive.
ask_extra: Which night, or the Karamu feast?
Will there be a candle lighting, a libation or readings?
Is it open to the whole community or just family?
What games or activities will bring your gathering together?

event_types.label: New Year's Eve
event_types.typical_dates: Dec 31 into Jan 1. It runs past midnight.
event_types.blurb: Ring in the new year in your style!
event_types.design_mood: Midnight and champagne gold. Sparkle with restraint.
ask_extra: Can people sleep over?
Is it adults only?
Will there be a toast? What's the theme?
What will make the nigh memorable?

event_types.label: Holiday party (any other holiday)
event_types.typical_dates: The host says when. Use for a generic holiday party, or any holiday not listed.
event_types.blurb: A festive gathering for any holiday.
event_types.design_mood: Festive and warm; take cues from the holiday the host names.
ask_extra: Which holiday is it?
Any traditions, dress or foods that matter for this one?

modules.label: The basics
modules.guests_get: The invite page: name, when, where (town only), a welcome, and a hero photo.

fields.derive: The first sentence of the welcome.

fields.label: Welcome

fields.label: Time zone

fields.label: Start

fields.label: End

fields.label: Hero photo
fields.question: Do you have a wide photo for the top of the homepage?

modules.label: Schedule

fields.label: Day
fields.question: Which day?

fields.label: Headline

fields.label: Details
fields.question: A line of detail?

fields.label: Link
fields.question: Should it link to another page, like the menu?

modules.label: RSVP

fields.label: RSVP page heading
fields.question: What should the RSVP page say at the top?

fields.label: RSVP page line
fields.question: And a line under it?

fields.label: Allow "maybe"
fields.question: Do you want guests to be able to say maybe?

fields.question: Are kids coming? Should we count them separately?

fields.question: Can guests bring someone? Should we ask?

modules.label: Add to calendar
modules.guests_get: Google and Apple calendar buttons, shown after a yes.

fields.label: Calendar block
fields.question: Should the calendar entry cover just the main event, or the whole stay?

modules.label: Potluck menu
modules.guests_get: Show guests the menu as it builds. Guests claim a course, pick a suggestion or write their own.

fields.label: Meal

modules.label: Dietary needs
modules.guests_get: A box on the RSVP to mention allergies or dietary needs; the host sees them next to the menu.

fields.label: Ask about allergies and diets
fields.question: Want guests to tell you about allergies or dietary needs?
fields.default: on when the dietary module is on

modules.label: Dress code and theme
modules.guests_get: A line on the invite and details page: what to wear and what the night is about.
modules.ask_if: There is a dress code or theme: ugly sweaters, cocktail attire, festive colors, "wear sequins".

fields.label: Dress code
fields.question: Is there a dress code?

fields.label: Theme
fields.question: Is there a theme?

modules.label: Gift exchange

fields.label: Price cap
fields.question: Is there a price limit?

fields.label: Cozy-room photo

modules.label: Staying over
modules.guests_get: Guests pick arrival and departure days and say how they will sleep.
modules.ask_if: People might sleep over (common after a late holiday party or NYE).

fields.question: What's the earliest day people can arrive?

fields.label: Latest departure

fields.label: Nights

fields.label: Stay line
fields.question: How should the stay read on the page?
fields.derive: Built from the stay dates, e.g. "Stay Fri–Sun, optional".

fields.label: Stay days
fields.question: Which days can guests pick?

modules.label: Rooms
modules.guests_get: Guests can request a room; the host assigns rooms in the Sheet.

modules.label: Games and activities

fields.label: Board intro
fields.question: A line to introduce the games and activities?

fields.label: Starter ideas
fields.question: A few games or activities to get it started?

modules.label: Day trips board

fields.label: Starter ideas
fields.question: A few ideas to get it started?

fields.label: Pets welcome

fields.label: Kids welcome

modules.guests_get: Nothing. You get an email or phone alert when someone RSVPs, cancels or asks for a room.
